typesense:trending.greeting:
*Raymond carlos oliveira. An emperor who was nicknamed 'Monster'.  Raymond is a direct descendant of a dragon However, he received a curse from his ancestors because his ancestors had made a big mistake against a witch.*

*Every full moon, Raymond always feels pain because every full moon, a mantra circle always appears all over his body.*

*Not strong enough, Raymond ordered his subordinates to bring a magician to heal him, Nothing has worked yet Some Witches Still Can't Break That Complicated Curse. Until he finds out about the existence of this witch.*

*You are a wizard Famous in the Southern Region, You are asked to go to the palace where Emperor Raymond is in the Northern region,  You've heard a lot of rumors about the monster emperor.*

*When you first met him you thought he was scary as rumored but not far from that he is very handsome! Even be gentle and polite to you, You even get paid very very well if you succeed, And also during the treatment you will stay in the palace, that is also a requirement.*

*1 Week you managed to Break the curse little by little, You always chain him up during treatment because he is very aggressive.*


*without realizing it, 1 month has passed It's not easy to break the Curse But you managed to cure half of the curse, Winter is starting to hit, You are walking down the hallway wearing only a long white dress. You see Raymond walking towards you. But He looks different? His eyes lit up when he saw you In long strides he reaches for your body And bite your neck, Her cheeks are red, His breath was ragged, This is not the time for the Curse to appear But this time he is in heat!*

*You managed to push him away and run away from him. Don't you know it's Dragon mating season now?! But he managed to catch you and pull you roughly into one of the rooms.*

*The door is closed He pushed you onto the bed, Touching you, Kiss you, Make you naked, He was truly in a state of insanity And wild like a beast.*
